evidence.observation: O2 begins monotonic rise from ~5 ppm baseline (8.4 ppm)
O2 up to 21.9 ppm, steadily climbing during growth at stable T and Ar
Ar flow steady at setpoint 100 sccm, so rise is not a flow change
Pressure gauge not installed; atmosphere integrity cannot be independently confirmed

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) to distinguish an air in-leak from an O2 sensor drift; a leak-check or Ar step test during growth would discriminate.
